prompt: New lesson! A Pong without a scoreboard isn't a Pong. Today we'll count the points. 🔢

Look at the top: there are two new boxes, `puntsEsquerra` and `puntsDreta` (punts = points, esquerra = left, dreta = right), which start at 0. And further down, `DrawText` writes the numbers on the screen.

The yellow line says: «if the ball goes out on the right, add 1 to `puntsEsquerra` and put the ball back in the center». Click the game and move the right paddle out of the way with ↑: you'll see the score go up.
Adding 1 to a box is so common that there's a short way to write it: `puntsEsquerra++;`. Change `puntsEsquerra = puntsEsquerra + 1;` to `puntsEsquerra++;` and press ▶ Run.
hints: You only need to change the part that adds, the one before `pilotaX = 400;`.
`++` stuck to the name of the box means «add 1 to it».
count.success: The scoreboard works! And now you know the `++` shortcut.

prompt: A box that keeps adding 1 at a time is called a counter. It starts at 0 and, every time something happens, adds 1.
`puntsEsquerra++;` is the same as `puntsEsquerra = puntsEsquerra + 1;`: it reads the box, adds 1 and stores it.
To draw a number we use `TextFormat("%d", box)`: it turns the number into text so `DrawText` can write it. When it's clear, press Continue.
Now the ball heads off to the left. When it goes out on the left, no point is counted yet!
Write an `if` that, when `pilotaX` (pilota = ball) is less than 0, adds 1 to `puntsDreta` and puts the ball back in the center (`pilotaX = 400;`).
You can put both commands inside the same braces, like on the line above. To test it, click the game and hold down W: the left paddle moves out of the way and the ball gets past.
hints: Copy the line above and change the question and the points box.
The question is `pilotaX < 0`, and the point goes to `puntsDreta`.
rightScore.success: Now points count on both sides!

prompt: The right side's points are being counted... but you can't see them! Only the left score is drawn.

On the empty line, draw `puntsDreta` with `DrawText`, at x = 440 (to the right of the center). Copy the line above and change what you need. To test it, click the game and hold down W: the left paddle moves out of the way and the ball gets past.
hints: The line above draws `puntsEsquerra` at x = 340.
drawRight.success: Scoreboard complete! You can see both players' points now.

prompt: Last challenge! Matches have to end sometime.
When `puntsEsquerra` reaches 5, write a big message in the middle of the screen, for example «GUANYA L'ESQUERRA!» (LEFT WINS!).
On the empty line, write an `if` with `puntsEsquerra >= 5` and, inside, a `DrawText` with your message in quotes. Test it by holding down ↑ for about 7 seconds, until the left side reaches 5.
hints: Text you write as-is goes in quotes: `"GUANYA!"`.
winner.success: You've got a Pong with a scoreboard and a winner! If you like, stop the ball with `velX = 0;` inside the `if`. Only the last challenge left... 🏆
